captions.detailed: A hydraulic dropper seatpost featuring a matte black outer tube with a prominent seat-tube binder ring and a side hydraulic port fitting near its base. A silver-metallic inner post extends telescopically from the outer tube on a prismatic joint. At the top of the inner post is a single-bolt saddle rail clamp head with a revolute tilt-adjust pivot, securing a black padded bicycle saddle supported by parallel steel cradle rails.
captions.instruction: Generate a parametric 3D model of an adjustable hydraulic dropper seatpost with a bicycle saddle. The model should feature a black outer sleeve with a seatpost clamp, a silver inner telescoping tube, a rail clamp head with adjustable tilt, and a black saddle with parallel rails.
captions.factory: Construct the outer tube and inner post using cylindrical primitives. Create the seatpost binder ring and side hydraulic port by combining boxes and cylinders via boolean operations. Model the saddle rail clamp head using a combination of boxes and cylinders, and construct the saddle shell using a loft or swept profile with parallel cylindrical sweeps for the steel cradle rails. Finally, define a prismatic articulation between the outer and inner tubes, and a revolute joint for the saddle tilt mechanism.
